set.body: Goal: turn the new generic pipeline graph algebra into a usable ScalaFIM pipeline system, not just a correct DAG core. Scope: ergonomic typed authoring, named output access, pure receipts/provenance, Future execution policy hardening, and one real in-memory fMRI pipeline proof. Non-goals: no external CLI/container runner, no scheduler dependency, no domain logic inside the generic pipeline module. Acceptance: pipeline JVM/JS tests pass; README/docs describe authoring and interpreters; at least one in-memory ScalaFIM domain workflow runs through the pipeline and matches direct API execution.
set.title: EPIC: Make scalafim-pipeline a working typed pipeline system
